summary:
Implemented the rich_measure feature, but nothing has been run: I was told not to run tests or code, so all checks were by reading.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: Tree.__rich_measure__ walks the tree iteratively with an explicit stack, indenting by 4 cells per level and passing max_width unchanged to labels.
- rich/align.py: Align constrains its wrapped renderable to the measured maximum (or min of that and an explicit width); Align and VerticalCenter get reprs; new public VerticalCenter renders with newline-segment vertical padding based on console.size.height and delegates measurement.
- rich/console.py: print passes justify into _collect_renderables unchanged; render options use justify="default".
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 marked Unreleased, with an Added subheading for both entries.
- tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py: added repr, VerticalCenter render/measure, and tree measurement tests per the acceptance criteria.

Choices: Align's repr uses the runtime class name; tree level decrements only when a child list is exhausted and the stack is non-empty.

Unverified: the test suite has not been run, including the VerticalCenter render expectation "\n\nfoo\n\n\n". Nothing was committed.
